description: MB-326KD, white with tip tanks, mounted on a landscaped mound on the palm-lined approach avenue to the Abu Dhabi Polytechnic campus at Al Ain, about 180 m from the campus buildings. Sharply resolved on Esri World Imagery acquired 21 September 2025. Further instructional airframes are reported inside the campus but none has been identified.
museum_name: Abu Dhabi Polytechnic Al Ain Campus
